run.not_a_stop: A qualification gate that FAILs (expected or not) is recorded and never stops the run.

D1.description: Plant and timing. The task builds the Policy F simulator; scripted controller commands [vx, vy, vz, yaw_rate] (vehicle frame) are held for 0.1 s per action and applied through sim_env.step, bypassing the task's governor, altitude loop, rewards and resets. Every physics substep is logged through env_manager.set_physics_step_callback; the motor reference is read by a call-through wrapper of the motor model's update_motor_thrusts.

gates.D1-T1: Every action spans exactly round(0.1/dt) substeps, the logged command is constant within it, and physical time per action is 0.1 s (|err| <= 1e-9 s).
gates.D1-M1: Fidelity: each logged motor thrust equals an independent recomputation of the production update (RPM domain, gain h + h^2/2 + h^3/6 + h^4/24, h = dt/(dt + tau), tau = 0.04 s) from the logged reference and previous thrust, within 1e-4 relative + 1e-6 N.
gates.D1-M2: Intended-lag agreement: the per-substep effective RPM-domain gain is within 0.5 % of the exact first-order lag 1 - exp(-dt/tau) on substeps with |w_ref - w| > 1 % of w (the EQ-1B M3 tolerance). The EQ-1B named-method FAILs (M1/M2) stay recorded separately.
gates.D1-C1: Non-contact fixtures 0-19: at every action boundary, the 5 ms versus 2.5 ms position difference <= 0.01 m and attitude difference <= 0.5 deg, and the 5-vs-2.5 maximum is smaller than the 10-vs-5 maximum (when the latter exceeds 1e-6).
gates.D1-H1: Fixture 0, last 2 s: total motor thrust within 1 % of m*g with m = 0.25 kg (URDF base 0.225 + 4 x 0.00625) and g = 9.81.
gates.D1-V1: Velocity steps (fixtures 1, 2, 3, 4, 7): mean horizontal velocity over the last 1.0 s within 5 % of the command.
gates.D1-B1: Braking fixtures 13-15: measured stopping distance from the brake command to |v_xy| < 0.05 m/s is <= the riskcap model v*0.1 + v^2/(2*2.9608856678).
gates.D1-A1: Tilt never exceeds 45 deg (NAVRL_MAX_TILT_DEG read as a state bound) in any fixture at any substep.
gates.D1-K1: Contact fixtures 20-23: the first substep with contact force > 0.05 N lies within [first geometric overlap substep - 1 - ceil(0.004 / (v*dt)), first overlap substep + 1], overlap from an oriented-box SAT test of the 0.28 x 0.28 x 0.08 m collision box (logged pose) against the bar box.
gates.D1-K2: Characterisation (no pass gate): first-contact time, speed and tilt at contact and 0.5 s after, the task's crash-detection delay (to the end of the contact action), and the spread of first-contact time across dt.

D2.description: Sensor and rendering scenes. The drone is placed at env position (20, 20, 1.0) with yaw 0; bars are placed by root-state writes with the Warp mesh refitted; the camera is rendered with the production detector.render_raw_rgbd and the LiDAR with sim_env.render(sensors) after the target is mirrored into the LiDAR buffer; no physics step is taken. Each scene is rendered at three body attitudes and twice: with its bars and target alone (bars parked).
D2.bar_rule: A bar is specified by its centre x and either centre y or an edge: {'x': X, 'edge_left_y': Y} puts its right face (min y) at Y; {'x': X, 'edge_right_y': Y} puts its left face (max y) at Y. Slots are taken in index order; their recorded half extents are used by every reference.

gates.D2-R1: Camera target render: on robust pixels (pixel-centre ray verdict unchanged under +-0.01 px perturbation), the rendered target mask equals the analytic visible mask (sphere r = 0.15 m, bar boxes) exactly and the target depth is within 1e-4 m.
gates.D2-R2: Camera obstacle depth at its native 40 x 24 grid: within 1e-4 m of the analytic ray/box depth (far plane 10 m) on robust rays.
gates.D2-R3: The 160 x 90 depth frame delivered to perception equals the per-pixel analytic depth (target or bars, far 10 m) within 1e-4 m on robust pixels.
gates.D2-L1: LiDAR: each robust beam's range equals the analytic slant range from the body origin along the declared yaw-only ray table (azimuth +180 deg decreasing by 5 deg per bin, elevation rows +20/+10/0/-10 deg; bars, target sphere r = 0.20 m; no return = 12 m) within 1e-4 m.
gates.D2-Y1: Declared yaw-only mount: camera RGB/depth and LiDAR at roll 15 deg and pitch 15 deg are bitwise equal to level. Hardware realism of that idealisation is NOT_TESTED.
gates.D2-F1: Fusion on rendered inputs: the production fused scan for each in-FOV beam equals the analytic body-origin horizontal range within 1e-4 m (EQ-1A A1/A2 predict FAIL).
gates.D2-A1: Camera measurement on rendered frames (S00-S03, S22): production direction <= 0.5 px; centre range within 1e-4 m (EQ-1A A7 predicts the range FAIL).
gates.D2-O1: Occlusion classes: the current indicator set computed from the rendered outputs (frustum, offline centre ray, 8-ray rim proxy, rendered pixel count) equals the independent analytic label (8 x 8 sub-pixel target-alone and visible support) in every target scene; zero rendered pixels never alone stands for FULL.
gates.D2-S1: Scale: in clear scenes the rendered target pixel count equals the analytic pixel-centre count exactly, and the detector's visibility equals count >= 2.
gates.D2-N1: Camera negatives N0-N8: the detector reports no target.
gates.D2-N2: LiDAR negatives with association_beam_deg: with a track primed where a target would be (bar front surface + 0.15 m along the beam), the production association does not accept the bar return (EQ-1A A6 predicts FAIL).
gates.D2-T1: Capture and delivery: for every render, the capture step counter equals the delivery step counter (zero-latency delivery as declared).

D3.description: Task-level GT firewall with Policy F in closed loop (rl_games player built as runner.py builds it; deterministic actions). At branch steps the observation computation is repeated from the pre-step perception state with the rendered camera and LiDAR tensors of that step replayed, while only privileged/evaluator/critic fields are changed. The official trajectory always continues from branch A.
D3.reset_branches: the first 2 steps at which some env has just reset (beyond step 5)
privileged_mutations: obs_dict entries whose name contains 'segmentation' (scaled and offset)
evaluator adapters detached during the branch

branches.B_perm: privileged tensors of env i replaced by those of env (i+1) mod N
branches.B_subset: only even envs mutated; odd envs must be bitwise unchanged
branches.P_control: positive control: target_position moved and the sensors re-rendered (no replay); the actor input must change for envs with the target in view

gates.D3-F1: B_all: 898-D actor rows bitwise equal to branch A for every env at every branch step; deterministic actions bitwise equal.
gates.D3-P1: Positive control changes the actor input of at least one env per branch step where some env has its target in the camera frustum.
gates.D3-R1: RMS mean/var/count digest equals the frozen digest after restore and at the end; the model stays in eval mode.
gates.D3-T1: Camera render, LiDAR render, observation and action counters show zero-step delivery latency on every recorded step.
gates.D3-B1: D3-F1..F4 and D3-R1 hold for N = 1, 2, 4 and 128 (cross-N trajectories are recorded, not compared bitwise).
gates.D3-S1: Actor width 898 and Policy F SHA verified in-process; aerial_gym imported from the worktree.

development_smoke: Before the official run, mechanical smoke runs of the launcher may run in the session scratchpad with reduced fixtures; they are not evidence, never written under results/, and fixtures/gates above are not changed by them.
